notes: The person's note (docs/e2ee-plan.md): UTF-8 JSON {"root": the root their phones and browsers trust, "folders": {folder id: the newest version of its key they saw}}, locked with HKDF-SHA256 of the person's private key (share-e2ee-v1/note) and the aad note:<user id> (contract/crypto/lock.json). Each phone or browser adds what it saw; the next one, e.g. after a sign-in with the password, starts from it (GET /api/keys: person.note). Starting over with a new person key drops it. 409 no_key for a person without a key; 400 bad_request for an empty one, or one over 1 MiB.
